subject: Analytics
question:
Which pair of expressions equals −tan(θ), where θ is the angle shown?
Choices:
A:tan(π+θ) and tan(π/2−θ)
B:tan(π+θ) and tan(2π−θ)
C:tan(2π−θ) and tan(π−θ)
D:tan(π/2−θ) and tan(π−θ)
original_question:
Which two of the following expressions are OPPOSITE of $\tan (\theta)$ ?
Choose 2 answers:
Choices:
A:$\tan (\pi+\theta)$
B:$\tan \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)$
C:$\tan (2 \pi-\theta)$
D:$\tan (\pi-\theta)$
